description: Checked sport-stat facts (plain sentences with the stat, value and as-of date) for one game (home + away), or with Storylines Pro or Publisher for one player or team. Stats only: no prices, picks or chances. Free: 3 facts a game; Creator 12; Pro and Publisher 30.

entity.description: The player or team name (kind player or team).

home.description: Home team, as get_storylines_games lists it (for a game).

kind.description: matchup (default), player or team. player and team need Storylines Pro or Publisher.

sport.description: Sport key, for example nfl, nba, nhl, mlb, ncaaf, soccer, cricket.

team.description: Soccer player only: his club, so we can check the competition is covered.

name: get_storylines_facts
title: Storylines stat facts
